text:
deploy-bot: starting staged deploy for release v2.9.2 -> v2.9.2. Change window 2026-03-20 02:00-04:00 UTC. Components: api, runtime, console, router. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 10m steps. Pinning: api=v2.9.2, runtime=quant-kernel-1, console=frontend-1.12. Router rules updated for header-based routing. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20/v2.9.2 :rocket:
maria: ack. quick check: is kernel swap gated behind feature flag? runtime team watching for batch/latency spikes. @sanjay
sanjay: yes — kernel is behind flag `runtime.kernel.switch=v1->quant-kernel-1`. Canary keeps kernel enabled on 5% only. dashboards: /dashboards/runtime-kernel and /alerts/rt-latency. I'll watch KV cache warmup.
elaine: console will remain pinned to frontend-1.12 to avoid the telemetry widget roll. We'll keep the UI flags off for the change window.
tom: router rule is: if header `x-rw-pin=live` -> route to runtime-v2.9.2; otherwise default. I'll manually step weights. Quick rollback snippets if needed:
```
# route weight rollback
rwctl router update --service router --set-weight runtime=runtime-v2.9.1:100
rwctl deploy rollback --service api --to v2.9.1 --region eu
```
deploy-bot: deploy started at 2026-03-20T02:05:34Z. Canary deployed at 5% EU region first. Observability links posted to thread. :eyes: 
maria: seeing small tail-latency bump on /chat (EU) — p50 +200ms, p95 +800ms. Investigating logs now.
sanjay: digging in. preliminary looks like KV-cache warmup + transient batch backpressure. I'm increasing batch window to 20ms to smooth bursts and pausing kernel ramp. Executing:
```
rwctl runtime update --service runtime --flag runtime.kernel.switch=false --region eu
rwctl runtime config set --batch-window 20ms --region eu
```
tom: pausing router weight increases for EU. Holding at 5%.
kevin: ops here — what's rollback threshold? propose: errors >1% or p95 >1.5s sustained for 5m -> full rollback. who will run it? @maria @sanjay
maria: I can run runtime rollback for EU. Plan: `rwctl deploy rollback runtime --to v2.9.1 --region eu` then pin api back to v2.9.1 for EU if errors persist.
sanjay: standby — will confirm cache state then give thumbs. If KV warmup fixes within 4m we continue.
elaine: console saw some 500s against api from the canary pods; switching console in EU to talk to api v2.9.1 only until cleared. 
deploy-bot: canary paused at 5% (manual hold). No further rollouts. EU console routing reverted; runtime kernel flag disabled. :white_check_mark: 
maria: rolling back console-side routing done for EU. watching metrics.
sanjay: p95 returning to normal after batch-window bump — down to 420ms. holding for 10m before deciding.
kevin: noted. if we need to rollback fully, use this sequence: 1) router weight -> runtime-v2.9.1 100% 2) deploy rollback api/runtime -> v2.9.1 3) clear pins. who will coordinate?
maria: I'll coordinate steps 1-2. tom can execute router weight change.
tom: Roger. ready to execute if maria gives the go.
deploy-bot: current state summary: canary paused (5% EU), kernel flag off, console pinned to api v2.9.1 in EU, batch-window=20ms. Next status update in 5m or on any threshold breach. Link to incident tracking: https://redwood.internal/incidents/R-2345.
kevin: thanks everyone. we'll log a follow-up doc and short postmortem if rollout resumes or we rollback.
maria: updating the release notes with the quick rollback playbook and timeline. will post final notes here when we either continue or cut.
